label: Index status (Capella Indexes UI)
type: the Capella Indexes page's own status enum (ready/pause/warmup) - a genuinely different value set from the promoted index-state DDL-lifecycle enum
note: Do not conflate with index-state (the SQL++ DDL lifecycle enum: scheduled for creation/deferred/building/pending/online/offline/abridged) - same subject (a GSI index's condition), two different, unreconciled vocabularies: one from the statement reference, one from the management UI. No page states a mapping between the two; left separate rather than guessed at, same discipline as the ontology's other same-word/same-subject collisions.
